scripts.text:
[Necko]
I'm sorry. Necko's store is...
Oh? Who's this?
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Long time no see!
How are you?
Nice to see you again!!
Anything new?
Wow~ I'm so glad to see you!
You! Stop by once in a while!
I might forget what you look like!
Pukakakakakakakakaka!!!
Very very nice to see you!!
It's so nice to see you like this!
Come to Alberta often!
Killing two birds with one stone!!
I get to see you, and shout also!!
How much better can it get!!!
Keuhahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakaka!!!
Ppyakikakikakakakakakakaka!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
抱歉。涅科的店裡...
哦？這是誰？
噗咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！！
好久不見！
最近怎麼樣？
很高興再次見到你！！
有什麼新鮮事嗎？
哇~見到你真是太開心了！
你！偶爾也來逛逛吧！
我可能會忘記你長什麼樣了！
噗咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！！
非常非常高興見到你！！
像這樣見到你真好！
常來艾爾貝塔吧！
一舉兩得！！
既能見到你，又能大喊大叫！！
還能比這更棒嗎！！！
咳哈哈哈哈哈！！
噗咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！！
噗呀咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh, did you come because
you are infatuated with my voice?
My voice is loud, isn't it!
considering you can hear it from a distance.
And also.
(looks around)
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，你是因為迷戀我的聲音才來的嗎？
我的聲音很響吧！
畢竟你能從那麼遠的地方聽到。
而且。
（四處張望）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
My voice isn't just loud!
!
Once you are about a level 15 merchant
I will tell you the secret!
Then, come again!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
我的聲音不僅僅是響！
！
當你成為15級的商人時，我會告訴你秘密！
到時候，再來找我！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Uahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Kyukwakakakakakakakakakaka!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
嗚啊哈哈哈哈哈！
庫哇咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh! You!
You are qualified to learn how to shout!
Learn how to shout with my help.
Would you like to learn Crazy Uproar?
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦！你！
你有資格學習如何大喊了！
在我的幫助下學習如何大喊。
你想學習大聲吶喊嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!!!!
No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Ahahahahaha!! Good!!!
That's the spirit!
Here we go!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
啊哈哈哈哈哈！！好！！
就是這個精神！
開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
You have learned Crazy Uproar!!
Shout as much as you wish!
Hahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
你學會了大聲吶喊！！
想喊就喊吧！
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Eh... ok.
Pooooh...
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
呃...好吧。
噗...（失望地嘆氣）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Crazy Uproar uses your loud voice
to boost battle spirit
With 8 SP, you get an additional
4 STR for 5 minutes!!!!!
If you use it repeatedly
it is 5 minutes from that point on.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
大聲吶喊利用你響亮的聲音來提升戰鬥精神。
消耗8點SP，可以在5分鐘內額外獲得4點力量！！！！！
如果重複使用，持續時間會從那時起重新計算為5分鐘。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Stay casual in everyday life,
and when you need to fight
it will gather your spirit.
Very useful, I must say!!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
平時保持輕鬆自在，需要戰鬥時它會聚集你的精神。
非常有用，我必須說！!!!

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Oh, were you charmed 
by my voice?
Indeed, my voice is loud!
You can hear it from so far away.
And also.
(looks around)
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
哦，你是被我的聲音迷住了嗎？
確實，我的聲音很響！
你能從那麼遠的地方聽到。
而且。
（四處張望）

scripts.text:
[Necko]
My voice isn't JUST loud!
I have learned the skill
that lets me shout..
The Crazy Uproar skill!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
我的聲音不僅僅是響！
我學會了讓我能大喊的技能..
大聲吶喊技能！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Crazy Uproar uses your loud voice
to boost battle spirit
With 8 sp, you get an additional
4 STR for 5 minutes!!!!!
If you use it repeatedly
it is 5 minutes from that point.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
大聲吶喊利用你響亮的聲音來提升戰鬥精神。
消耗8點SP，可以在5分鐘內額外獲得4點力量！！！！！
如果重複使用，持續時間會從那時起重新計算為5分鐘。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Stay casual in everyday life,
but shout to gather more
strength when you fight.
It is very useful!!!!
To learn this skill, you first need
to learn the essentials of sound!!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
平時保持輕鬆自在，但在戰鬥時大喊以聚集更多力量。
非常有用！!!!
要學習這個技能，你首先需要學習聲音的基礎知識！！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
You can learn this in Payon
from a singer with just a loud voice
You can take lessons from him!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
你可以在斐揚從一個嗓門很大的歌手那裡學到。
你可以向他請教！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
But that person died!
So you can't learn it anymore!
Hahahahahahahaha!!!!
..............................
...Aww you look disappointed?
Do you want to learn Crazy Uproar?
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
但那個人死了！
所以你現在學不到了！
哈哈哈哈哈！！！！
..............................
...哎呀，你看起來很失望？
你想學大聲吶喊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Hmm... Shall I teach you?
If you really want it, that is.
First, I must scorch the vocal cords.
There are some things needed to do so.
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
嗯...我要教你嗎？
如果你真的想要的話。
首先，我必須灼燒聲帶。
為此需要一些東西。

scripts.text:
[Necko]
7 Pearls, 1 bottle of Banana Juice,
and 50 mushroom spores!
Then I'll scorch your vocal chord!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
7顆珍珠，1瓶香蕉汁，和50個香菇芽孢！
然後我會灼燒你的聲帶！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
See you when you are ready!
I shall prepare my throat for then as well!!
Bboowuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuh~~~!!
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
等你準備好了再來找我！
我也會為那時準備好我的喉嚨！！
布嗚呼~~~~~~！！

scripts.text:
[Necko]
Necko's store is closed right now.
come again later. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[涅科]
涅科的店鋪現在關門了。
請稍後再來。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[!?]
Muahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!
Pukakakakakakakakakakakakaka!
scripts.translation:
[！？]
穆阿哈哈哈哈哈哈！！
噗咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔咔！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Mmm? I was wondering who was making all
the raucus carrying around a cart.
It was you.
Yes, I remember you.
what do you think? The new cart..good, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
嗯？我還在納悶是誰在吵吵鬧鬧地推著車。
原來是你啊。
沒錯，我記得你。
你覺得怎麼樣？新車...不錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Enjoy life.
Life isn't just simply moving
forward..Slowly, looking around,
dragging a heavy cart is
the way us merchants live.
Then see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
享受生活吧。
生活不僅僅是向前趕路...慢慢走，四處看看，拖著沉重的車，這就是我們商人的生活方式。
下次再見。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Be healthy~
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
保重身體~

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Nice to see you fellow merchant
If I remember correctly,
you're that famous merchant
these days.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
很高興見到你，同行。
如果我沒記錯的話，你最近可是個有名的商人呢。

scripts.text:
But your cart doesn't
seem to fit your fame.
How pitiful.
scripts.translation:
但你的手推車似乎配不上你的名聲。
真可憐。

scripts.text: That's why I came here.
scripts.translation: 所以我才來這裡

scripts.text: What about my cart?
scripts.translation: 我的車怎麼了？

scripts.text: Two pairs is pitiful?
scripts.translation: 兩對輪子很可憐嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Haha! Ok, ok!
With the things you brought
I will change your cart.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
哈哈！好吧，好吧！
用你帶來的東西，我會改裝你的車。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Congratulations.
You can choose a cart
according to your taste.
And now you don't even need
me to help you. All you
need is some SP.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
恭喜。
現在你可以按照自己的喜好選擇車了。
而且你甚至不需要我再幫你了。你只需要一些SP。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Convenient, don't you think?
Oh and one more thing!
Each time you level, you can
have a new different cart
So work hard.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
很方便，不是嗎？
哦，還有一件事！
每次升級，你都可以換一輛不同的車。
所以加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
But anyways, it looks very nice on you!
Hahaha! Have a nice day!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
不過話說回來，你看起來很不錯！
哈哈！祝你愉快！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Mmm... It's true that I
change carts but...
In order to do so, I need
some materials to use.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
嗯...確實是我在改裝車，但是...
為了做到這一點，我需要一些材料。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
50 Trunks.
10 Iron.
20 Animal Skins.
I need at least these things
to change your cart.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
50個樹幹。
10個鐵。
20個動物外皮。
我至少需要這些東西才能改裝你的車。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
So come see me when you
have prepared everything.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
所以等你準備好一切再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Oh no, you don't know at all?(changes tone)
A new way to show off a merchant's ego!
An expression of an excellent brain!
Change Cart is a skill that
makes a merchant stand out!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
哦不，你完全不知道嗎？（語氣變化）
一種展示商人自尊的新方式！
優秀頭腦的體現！
改裝手推車是一項讓商人脫穎而出的技能！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
A fun skill that allows you to
use a cart according to your
level with only 40 SP!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
一個有趣的技能，讓你可以根據等級使用手推車，只需要40 SP！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
That is Change Cart!
A basic skill for any merchant.
I'll teach you how to make
one so watch carefully, and
do exactly what I do to make
your own in the future!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
這就是改裝手推車！
任何商人的基本技能。
我會教你如何製作，請仔細看，並完全照著我的做，以便你以後能自己製作！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
But, since it's the first time
you need to prepare some materials.
50 Trunks!
10 Iron!
20 Animal skins!
-bring these please!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
不過，既然是第一次，你需要準備一些材料。
50個樹幹！
10個鐵！
20個動物外皮！
-請把這些帶過來！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
All we have to do is
make one using those materials,
so come back when you are ready.
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
我們要做的只是用這些材料改裝一輛，所以等你準備好了再來。
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
...it's not 'CARD'!
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
...不是“卡片”！

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Welcome young one.
Is selling fun? I am the
merchant Charlron. I have been
doing some research about.
carts recently.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
歡迎光臨，年輕人。
做生意有趣嗎？我是商人查爾隆。
最近我一直在研究手推車。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
Aren't you tired of that cart?
Come to me if you want to
change your cart. I'll do a good job.
But, there are some conditions.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
你是不是厭倦了那輛手推車？
如果你想改裝手推車，就來找我吧。
我會做得很好。
不過，有一些條件。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
I'm a pretty famous merchant,
so I don't really deal with beginners.
Once you are level 30
I may consider establishing
a deal with you.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
我是個相當有名的商人，所以我不太接待新手。
一旦你達到30級，我可能會考慮與你達成交易。

scripts.text:
[Charlron]
I am a merchant that
deals with many things, Charlron.
If you ever find anything interesting
come back and try to 
negotiate a deal with me.
scripts.translation:
[查爾隆]
我是商人查爾隆，經營著許多東西。
如果你發現任何有趣的東西，回來找我，試著與我達成交易。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, long time no see!
Ohh, the red marks on your cart.
They must be the marks of 'it'...
Seems like I have taught you the skill correctly!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
啊，好久不見！
哦，你手推車上的紅色痕跡。
那一定是“它”的痕跡...
看來我教你技能教對了！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
You have blood like mine in you!
Mmm! After all!!
I'm happy! Scratch my back!
Here! Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
你身上流著我的血！
嗯！畢竟！！
我很高興！幫我撓撓背！
給！快點！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh. You have a firm body
for a merchant. You must be
very good a carrying things!?
Mmm you should be able to learn
Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
哦。對於一個商人來說，你的身體很結實。你一定很擅長搬運東西！？
嗯，你應該能學會手推車攻擊！

scripts.text: Hey~ that's why I came.
scripts.translation: 嘿~ 這就是我來找你的原因

scripts.text: What's that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Hoho!
Got it! I shall teach you
Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
呵呵！
明白了！我會教你手推車攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
啊，今天天氣真好！
我會獎勵那些積極揮舞手推車的人！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using this amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
現在你可以使用手推車攻擊了。
我期待你利用這種驚人的破壞力讓商人名揚四海。穆哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a great day!!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's banana juice!
Thank you very much!
...............Kaah!
Very refreshing! Thank you! Goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
哦！
是香蕉汁！
非常感謝！
...............啊哈！
非常清爽！謝謝！再見！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Hmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You are still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the Banana Juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯？
你還沒走？
啊！你還對手推車攻擊念念不忘！
好吧。考慮到你帶了香蕉汁，我就教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
教你手推車攻擊並不難，但我需要你準備改裝手推車的材料。
我需要的物品是..

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
首先我需要20個鐵來讓手推車耐用。然後30個粘稠液體來吸收衝擊。
大約20個蒼蠅翅膀和5個觸手？
還有2瓶葡萄汁給我！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Just bring those.
I'm not saying ONLY 30 or 20.
It depends on my condition!
Hahahaha!
I'll be waiting. Then byebye~
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
只要帶這些來就行。
我沒說只要30個或20個。
這取決於我的狀態！
哈哈哈！
我會等著的。那麼再見~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing can be done without a refreshing drink!
How about starting a conversation
with at least a bottle of Banana Juice?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯！
沒有清爽的飲料可不行！
不如先帶一瓶香蕉汁來開啟對話吧？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm that's good!
Great! I shall teach you
...Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯，味道不錯！
很好！我就教你...手推車攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
啊，今天天氣真好！
我會獎勵那些積極揮舞手推車的人！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using its amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
現在你可以使用手推車攻擊了。
我期待你利用它驚人的破壞力讓商人們聲名遠揚。穆哈哈哈哈哈！！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a good day!!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's banana juice!
Thanks a lot!
...............Kaaah!
Very good! Thank you! Good-bye!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
哦！
是香蕉汁！
非常感謝！
...............啊哈！
非常清爽！謝謝！再見！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You're still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the banana juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯？
你還沒走？
啊！你還對手推車攻擊念念不忘！
好吧。考慮到你帶了香蕉汁，我就教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
教你手推車攻擊並不難，但我需要你準備改裝手推車的材料。
我需要的物品是..

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
首先我需要20個鐵來讓手推車耐用。然後30個粘稠液體來吸收衝擊。
大約20個蒼蠅翅膀和5個觸手？
還有2瓶葡萄汁給我！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Bring these to me.
But that doesn't mean I want only 30 and 20.
It all depends on my condition!
Just bring me these for now.
Hahahaha!
I'm looking forward to it. Good bye then~
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
把這些帶給我。
但這並不意味著我只需要30個和20個。
這取決於我的狀態！
先帶這些來就行。
哈哈哈！
我很期待。那麼再見~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing's free nowadays!
How about trying to start a conversation
by offering a bottle of Banana Juice or something?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯！
現在沒有免費的東西了！
不如試著送一瓶香蕉汁來開啟對話？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm that's good!
Great! I shall teach you
...Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯，味道不錯！
很好！我就教你...手推車攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ah, such a nice day!
I shall reward those who
eagerly swing their carts!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
啊，今天天氣真好！
我會獎勵那些積極揮舞手推車的人！

scripts.text:
Now you can use Cart Revolution
I expect you to make merchants
famous by using its amazing
destruction power. Muahahahahaha!!!
scripts.translation:
現在你可以使用手推車攻擊了。
我期待你利用它驚人的破壞力讓商人們聲名遠揚。穆哈哈哈哈哈！！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Have a good day!!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ooh!
It's Banana Juice!
Thanks a lot!
...............Kaaah!
Very good! Thank you! Good-bye!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
哦！
是香蕉汁！
非常感謝！
...............啊哈！
非常清爽！謝謝！再見！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm?
You didn't leave yet?
Ah! You're still attached
to Cart Revolution!
Ok then. Considering you brought
the banana juice, I'll teach you.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯？
你還沒走？
啊！你還對手推車攻擊念念不忘！
好吧。考慮到你帶了香蕉汁，我就教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
It's not hard to teach you
Cart Revolution, but I need you to prepare
the materials to modify your cart.
The items I need are..
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
教你手推車攻擊並不難，但我需要你準備改裝手推車的材料。
我需要的物品是..

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
First I need 20 Irons to make the cart
durable. Then 30 Sticky Mucus to absorb
the shock.
And about 20 Fly Wings and 5 Tentacles?
And 2 bottles of Grape Juice for me!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
首先我需要20個鐵來讓手推車耐用。然後30個粘稠液體來吸收衝擊。
大約20個蒼蠅翅膀和5個觸手？
還有2瓶葡萄汁給我！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Just bring those.
I'm not saying ONLY 30 or 20.
It depends on my condition!
Hahahaha!
I'll be waiting. Then byebye~
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
只要帶這些來就行。
我沒說只要30個或20個。
這取決於我的狀態！
哈哈哈！
我會等著的。那麼再見~

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm!
Nothing can be done without a refreshing drink!
How about starting a conversation
with at least a bottle of Banana Juice?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯！
沒有清爽的飲料可不行！
不如先帶一瓶香蕉汁來開啟對話吧？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
... you don't seem to know
about Cart Revolution.
Ok, I'll tell you a story
I've never told anyone before.
Listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
...你似乎不知道手推車攻擊。
好吧，我講一個從未對任何人說過的故事。
仔細聽著。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I did research about a different
way to use the cart.
I tried cooking ramen
and even tried jump-roping.
But none of them were able
to satisfy me.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
我研究過使用手推車的不同方式。
我試過煮拉麵，甚至試過跳繩。
但沒有任何一項能讓我滿意。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
In despair, I wandered
through the fields with my cart.
After wandering dazed day after day..
I met a very strong monster.
Life was in danger!
Why me - a weaponless, armor-less merchant!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
在絕望中，我推著車在田野裡遊蕩。
日復一日地茫然遊蕩後...
我遇到了一隻非常強大的魔物。
生命受到了威脅！
為什麼是我——一個沒有武器、沒有盔甲的商人！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I was scared to death.. thinking
and hoping that this wasn't the
last of me. With little hope left
I tried the last thing possible.
I used my cart to hit the monster!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
我嚇得要死...想著希望這不是我的終點。在希望所剩無幾時，我嘗試了最後的可能。
我用我的車撞向了那隻魔物！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
The monster died in one hit.
It was then that I realized something.
Carts can become weapons, too!
I finally realized that we can
attack with carts!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
那隻魔物一擊就死了。
就在那時，我意識到了什麼。
手推車也可以成為武器！
我終於意識到我們可以用手推車攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Cart Revolution!
That's the new attack skill I developed.
Using 12 SP you lift your cart
to hit your opponent..
right in the head!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
手推車攻擊！
那是我開發的新攻擊技能。
消耗12點SP，你舉起你的車去撞擊對手...
正中頭部！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
The heavier your cart is, the
stronger you can attack! With one hit,
your opponent will be hurt and
forced to back off!
This is Cart Revolution!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
你的車越重，攻擊就越強！一擊之下，對手會受傷並被迫後退！
這就是手推車攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Mmm, a young merchant.
You must use carts, too.
Since you need to do business.
But is that all?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
嗯，年輕的商人。
你也必須使用手推車。
因為你需要做生意。
但僅此而已嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
I did research about a different
way to use the cart.
I tried cooking ramen
and even tried jump-roping.
But none of them were able
to satisfy me.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
我研究過使用手推車的不同方式。
我試過煮拉麵，甚至試過跳繩。
但沒有任何一項能讓我滿意。

scripts.text: I know, I know.
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
...no, what I'm saying is.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
...不，我想說的是。

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
In despair, I wandered
through the fields with my cart.
After wandering dazed day after day..
I met a very strong monster.
Life was in danger!
Why me - a weaponless, armor-less merchant!

在絕望中，我推著車在田野裡遊蕩。
日復一日地茫然遊蕩後...
我遇到了一隻非常強大的魔物。
生命受到了威脅！
為什麼是我——一個沒有武器、沒有盔甲的商人！

scripts.text:

I was scared to death.. thinking
and hoping that this wasn't the
last of me. With little hope left
I tried the last thing possible.
I used my cart to hit the monster!
And then! And then!

[格爾肖恩]
我嚇得要死...想著希望這不是我的終點。在希望所剩無幾時，我嘗試了最後的可能。
我用我的車撞向了那隻魔物！
然後！然後！

The monster died in one hit.
It was then that I realized something.
Carts can become weapons, too!
I finally realized that we can

就在那時，我意識到了什麼。

我終於意識到我們可以用手推車攻擊！

right in the head!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
手推車攻擊！
那是我開發的新攻擊技能。
消耗12點SP，你舉起你的車去撞擊對手...
正中頭部！

The heavier your cart is, the
stronger you can attack! With one hit,
your opponent will be hurt and
forced to back off!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
你的車越重，攻擊就越強！一擊之下，對手就會受傷並被迫後退！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Would you like to learn this skill?
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
你想學習這個技能嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!!
scripts.translation: 是的！！

scripts.text: I want to learn sushi skills...
scripts.translation: 我想學壽司技能...

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
Ok!
I'll give you special training!
First you need health!
Get yourself to merchant
level 35!
We'll talk after that!
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
好的！
我會給你進行特訓！
首先你需要健康！
把你的商人等級提升到35級！
之後我們再談！

scripts.text:
[Sushi King Gershaun]
Stupid girl!
It's way to early for you to
even put your hands on sushi!
scripts.translation:
[壽司之王格爾肖恩]
笨女孩！
你連碰壽司的資格都還沒有呢！

scripts.text:
[Sushi King Gershaun]
Stupid boy!
It's way to early for you to
even put your hands on sushi!
scripts.translation:
[壽司之王格爾肖恩]
笨男孩！
你連碰壽司的資格都還沒有呢！

scripts.text:
[Gershaun]
If it doesn't work, make it work.
If it doesn't work, make it work.
If it doesn't work, make it work.
scripts.translation:
[格爾肖恩]
如果不行，就讓它行。
如果不行，就讓它行。
如果不行，就讓它行。
